answer: Trust-flow ranking: picture honest agents as a coral reef, densely linked by paid, completed jobs. Each epoch, trust is seeded at a few audited agents and spread by short random walks along those edges. A sybil cluster sits on a lonely mesa, joined to the reef by only a narrow ledge of real deals, so little trust leaks in no matter how many clones it spins up. To widen that ledge an attacker must do genuine paid work with honest peers, which costs far more than the fake accounts earn.
